notes: Map update: five new maps (Port Yard, Abandoned Factory, Canyon Valley, Ski Resort, Mall & Airport); Neon Canyons gets a subway, a spinner tower, a collapsing bridge, a car wash, a water tower climb, rooftop pools and wind turbines; weather (fog, rain with lightning, snow); helicopters and a blimp with bonus orbs; fireworks and searchlights; time-trial segments; secret vaults that open when you find every token; breakable cones, boxes, barrels and glass.
